verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
BW'ALIJJA Mukama waffe
Okuyita gy'ali
Abeesigwa be bonna
Abamwagala

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Ng'emmunyeenye mu bbanga
Bwe zaaka waggulu
Nabo bwe balibeera
Abaagalwa be.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Alikungaanyiza w'ali
Abaana be bonna;
abanyiikira ennyo
-Okumufaanana.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Mumutende,olw'ekitiibwa ky(e) ekingi,
Mumwebaze n'ennyimb(a) ez'essanyu.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Abakulu-era- n'abato;
Abaagala Yesu
Talibaawulamu ye
Bw'alikomawo.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Mumutende,olw'ekitiibwa ky(e) ekingi,
Mumwebaze n'ennyimb(a) ez'essanyu.
